items.source: This is particularly useful for delegating to existing data access code that expects a ReactiveSession to work on and throws DriverException. For newly written code, it is strongly recommended to use CqlTemplate's more specific operations, for example a query or update variant.
items.translation: 这对于委托给现有的数据访问代码特别有用，这些代码期望在 ReactiveSession 上工作并抛出 DriverException。对于新编写的代码，强烈建议使用 CqlTemplate 的更具体操作，例如查询或更新变体。

items.source: Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain objects. Note that there's special support for single step actions: see ReactiveCqlTemplate.queryForObject(Statement, Class) etc. A thrown RuntimeException is treated as application exception: it gets propagated to the caller of the template.
items.translation: 允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即域对象或域对象的集合。请注意，单步操作具有特殊支持：请参阅 ReactiveCqlTemplate.queryForObject(Statement, Class) 等方法。抛出的 RuntimeException 被视为应用程序异常：它会被传播到模板的调用者。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(ReactiveSessionCallback) with an active Cassandra session.
items.translation: 由ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(ReactiveSessionCallback)调用，并传入一个活跃的 Cassandra 会话。

items.source: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - if thrown by a session method, to be auto-converted to a DataAccessException.
items.translation: com.datastax.oss.driver.api.core.DriverException - 如果由会话方法抛出，将自动转换为 DataAccessException。

items.source: DataAccessException - in case of custom exceptions.
items.translation: DataAccessException - 针对自定义异常的情况。

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个函数式接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: Generic callback interface for code that operates on a CQL ReactiveSession. Allows to execute any number of operations on a single ReactiveSession, using any type and number of Statements.
items.translation: 用于操作 CQLReactiveSession的通用回调接口。允许在单个ReactiveSession上执行任意数量的操作，可使用任意类型和数量的语句。

items.source: Gets called by ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(ReactiveSessionCallback) with an active Cassandra session. Does not need to care about activating or closing the ReactiveSession.
items.translation: 由ReactiveCqlTemplate.execute(ReactiveSessionCallback)调用，并传入一个活跃的 Cassandra 会话。无需关心激活或关闭ReactiveSession。
